# Campfire

> Campfire is a free, open-source songbook app for lyrics and chords, for Android, iOS, iPadOS, Windows, macOS, Linux, and the browser. It has setlists, chord diagrams and scales for guitar, ukulele, mandolin, banjo, and keyboard, a metronome, and a tuner. It works offline, with no ads, account, subscription, in-app purchases, or song limits.

Campfire is made by Péter Pandula and licensed under the Mozilla Public License 2.0. Every song is stored as a plain ChordPro text file on the device, and an optional Dropbox sync keeps the library the same on every device in real time.

- Layout: songs are drawn in as many columns as fit the screen at the chosen text size, with chord diagrams under the song, or beside it on a wide screen, lit for the part being read. Pages turn with a tap, a keyboard, or a page-turner pedal, a whole page or one column at a time. Auto-scroll is the other layout: one column that scrolls by itself, timed to the song's duration, at a speed adjustable per song. A lyrics-only mode hides the chords for singers, and a read-only mode locks editing on stage.
- Import: paste or share a song from any website, or just the page's link, or import ChordPro, plain text, PDF, and Word (.docx) files, zip archives, other songbook apps' backups, sets, and song files (such as .sbpbackup, .sbp, .onsong, and JSON exports), and ABC tunes. Everything runs on the device, with no online service: a small model built into the app leaves a page's menus, ads, and comments out, and the page of a shared link is read on the device too.
- Pictures and attachments: a song can show pictures, such as a photo of the sheet music, on its pages and in its PDF, and keep a PDF, a recording, or a video of up to 50 MB attached; both are synced, exported, and shared with the song.
- Setlists: each song's key, capo, and tempo per set, a countdown to the gig, the running time, PDF printing, and sharing as a zip file or as a link with a QR code.
- Metronome: each song stores its tempo, time signature, and accented beats, and in a set the tempo switches to the next song's on the next bar.
- Tuner: six-, seven-, eight-, and twelve-string guitar, four- and five-string bass, ukulele, mandolin, banjo, and violin, in many tunings, with a reference pitch from 415 to 466 Hz. The sound is analyzed on the device and never recorded.
- Sheet music: melodies written in ABC notation are drawn as staff notation, transposed with the song, in its chord notation, and printed in the PDF.
- Chords and scales: diagrams follow the instrument's tuning, every chord has alternative shapes, and the Scales tab draws every scale and mode in any key. Every song suggests the scales that fit it, and where to switch to another. Chords can be shown as letters, German, Latin, Nashville numbers, or Roman numerals.
- Privacy: no analytics or tracking, and no server: songs leave the device only when shared, exported, or synced.

- [Home page](https://campfire-songbook.com/): the features, screenshots, and download links for every platform
- [Web app](https://campfire-songbook.com/app/): the full app in the browser, with nothing to install
- [Support and FAQ](https://campfire-songbook.com/support/): how to import, share setlists, use the tuner, sync, and back up
- [Privacy policy](https://campfire-songbook.com/privacy/)
- [Source code](https://github.com/pandulapeter/campfire)
